title: Unifying Evaluation of Machine Learning Safety Monitors
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical metrics for evaluating machine learning safety monitors (Safety Gain, Residual Hazard, Availability Cost) in critical autonomous systems. While ML safety has ethical implications, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/faith aspects as a core component of its research. The safety analysis discussed is technical, related to identifying hazards and system failures, rather than philosophical ethics.
